answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 179756 Country: India Title: Is Organic mushroom halal? Question: I want to know if organic mushroom planted in farm is halal? Please suggest. Answer ID: 179756 Posted on: Sep 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 46/26/L=1/1442) Vegetation, i.e. things which grow in the ground they are pure and halal if they are not intoxicant, poisonous and deadly. It is lawful to consume, cultivate, buy and sell them. Mushroom is also a type of plant. However, some species of mushroom are harmful and deadly, so it shall be lawful to eat, cultivate, buy and sell the species of mushroom which are not deadly and harmful. You may learn from the experts about the useful (unharmful) species of mushroom. Plants, i.e. things which grow in the ground they are pure and halal if they are not intoxicant, poisonous and deadly. It is lawful to consume, cultivate, buy and sell them. Mushroom is also a type of plant. However, some species of mushrooms are harmful and deadly, so it shall be lawful to eat, cultivate, buy and sell the species of mushroom which are not deadly and harmful. You may learn from the experts about the useful (unharmful) species of mushroom. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
